axes.name: SERIAL_RECURRENCE
axes.value: Direct 25-year revival of a hyper-canonical operation. Same wordmark, same agency lineage (TBWA), same single-tagline anchor.
axes.evidence: Apple newsroom press release of 2024-01-15 explicitly cites the 1997 original and notes 'the wordmark returns unchanged'.

axes.name: AUCTORIALITY
axes.value: Strong — named director (Garth Davis), photographer (Annie Leibovitz), composer (Hans Zimmer), VO (Tilda Swinton). Public creative brief is itself an editorial signature.
axes.evidence: Press release lists all named creators and publishes the brief publicly.

axes.name: EXTERNAL_REFERENTIALITY
axes.value: Maximal — 25 living visionaries from 14 countries replace the deceased icons of 1997. The referentiality structure is preserved but updated.
axes.evidence: List of 25 visionaries from Doudna to Adichie published in the press release.

axes.name: PROMISE_STRATEGY
axes.value: Spiritual — tribal belonging to a lineage of visionaries. Identical promise structure to 1997 original.
axes.evidence: Direct line from manifesto-style positioning of 1997 to present iteration.

axes.name: META_CONSCIOUSNESS
axes.value: Moderate — publishing the creative brief publicly signals self-awareness of the operation as cultural artefact, not just commerce.
axes.evidence: Newsroom explicitly notes 'a first for Apple' on the public brief release.

performance.rationale: Strong design and editorial execution leveraging 25 years of pre-built cult-index legacy. Performance metrics still maturing one year post-launch — composite reflects projection rather than realised outcome.

summary: Apple revisits its 1997 Think Different campaign 25 years later with 25 contemporary visionaries, deploying a brand film, OOH across 41 cities, print, microsite, and — uniquely — a publicly released creative brief.
patternObservation: A SERIAL_RECURRENCE play executed with editorial restraint. Same tagline, same manipulation mode (DEALER), same external-referentiality structure as 1997 — but with living rather than deceased icons and a self-aware publication of the brief. The operation borrows nothing from the contemporary product cycle (Apple Vision Pro launches two weeks later, but is held at arm's length).
significance: The operation tests whether a 25-year-old brand manifesto pattern can re-anchor a brand identity in 2024. If the imitation count climbs over the next 24 months, it confirms that brand-manifesto revival is a viable late-cycle strategy for hyper-canonical brands.
